body: I noticed the dampness on my shoes pressing into the wooden boards beneath me. Despite not raining, there was a thin sheen of moisture clinging to the surfaces of the planks. It felt like the air itself had a slight chill against my skin now. A sense of protection washed over me—a warm, reassuring presence. I knew these planks could crumble under pressure if they were ever stepped upon too heavily. With an instinctive urge to offer my support, I took one step closer to the edges of the bridge, feeling its structure sway slightly. My hands moved instinctively towards the sturdy wood at either end as if grasping for something solid amidst this uncertain world.
